# Acme Enterprise Deployment Guide

This guide covers the operational commitments Acme makes to enterprise customers.

## Availability

Acme commits to 99.9% monthly uptime on the Enterprise plan. Service credits are issued against the following month's invoice when the commitment is missed.

## Recovery objectives

Acme's documented recovery point objective (RPO) is 15 minutes and its recovery time objective (RTO) is 4 hours for a regional outage. These objectives apply to the primary region; failover to a secondary region is operated by Acme and requires no action from the customer.

## Backups

Customer data is backed up hourly and retained for 35 days. Restoration from backup is tested quarterly, and the results of the most recent restoration test are available on request.

## Incident response

Enterprise customers have a named support contact and a 24x7 escalation path for production incidents. Severity one incidents receive a response within 30 minutes at any hour.

## Support tiers

Starter includes email support with a next business day response. Business includes priority support with a four hour response during business hours. Enterprise includes 24x7 support with a one hour response for severity one issues.
